Merman Construction's Quality Commitment
As a small family-owned business, Merman Construction takes pride in helping Montgomery and Chester County homeowners transform their spaces with additions and home remodeling projects. Steve Merman and his team treat every project like their own, bringing trusted craftsmanship, integrity, and careful attention to every detail.

Select one of the services below to learn more.
	
Home Additions

Primary suites, in-law suites, garages, and custom expansions for homes across Montgomery and Chester Counties. We use materials like Aquaguard® performance laminate flooring and engineered structural framing to ensure safe, long-lasting additions.

	
Stucco Remediation

Full removal and repair with James Hardie® siding, stone, or vinyl replacement to protect your exterior. We use Benjamin Opdyke HydroGap® drainable house wrap and HydroFlash® GP.

	
Windows & Doors

Energy efficient window replacements and premium entry doors that improve comfort, security, and home value. Brands such as ViWinco® Windows and Reeb® Doors are used.

	
Basements

Entertainment rooms, home gyms, playrooms, or in-law apartments, tailored to your property. Quality materials such as Diamond Cabinets and Sherwin-Williams paint.

	
Siding & Exterior

Expert installation of James Hardie®  fiber cement siding and Certainteed® vinyl siding to boost curb appeal and weather resistance.

	
Deck Installation

Built with Trex® and AZEK® composite materials for long lasting decks, porches, and pergolas.

	
Bathrooms & Kitchens

Beautifully finished kitchens and bathrooms designed for comfort and function. Quality materials from Kohler and Ferguson Plumbing Supply.

9
	
Craftmanship

We are a family-owned remodeling company that takes pride in traditional craftsmanship while applying modern building practices. Every project is built with precision, care, and long-lasting results.

9
	
Compliance

Merman Construction ensures that every home renovation complies with all local building codes and safety standards, giving homeowners confidence in both quality and reliability.

9
	
Serving Montgomery County & Chester County, PA

Our goal is simple: deliver expert craftsmanship and dependable service that homeowners can trust for lasting results. From home additions and stucco remediation to decks, bathroom remodels, and full home renovations, we bring the same level of planning and precision to every project.

Professional Home Remodeling and Stucco Remediation in Montgomery and Chester County

 

Merman Construction Inc provides professional home remodeling services for homeowners across Montgomery and Chester Counties. Our team specializes in home additions, basement finishing, kitchen and bathroom renovations, deck construction, and stucco remediation.

With more than 20 years of experience, we are a family owned contractor trusted throughout Collegeville, Phoenixville, Royersford, Plymouth Meeting, and nearby communities. Every project is built with lasting craftsmanship, personalized design, and a commitment to quality that adds comfort and value to your home.

ABOUT MERMAN CONSTRUCTION INC.

A Collegeville Construction Company Built on Trust, Craftsmanship, and Hands-On Experience

Merman Construction Inc. is a family-owned construction and remodeling company based in Collegeville, Pennsylvania. We work with homeowners throughout Montgomery and Chester County on larger residential projects, including home additions, stucco remediation, basement remodeling, exterior renovations, windows, doors, decks, and structural remodeling work.

VIEW OUR WORK
Start a Conversation
Why Homeowners Choose Merman Construction

A remodeling project is personal. Homeowners want to know who will be in their home, who is watching the details, and whether the company understands more than surface-level finish work.

Merman Construction is intentionally hands-on. Steve Merman began his career as a professional framer, building homes and residential developments throughout the region. That background still shapes the way we approach additions, exterior renovations, stucco remediation, basement projects, and larger remodeling work.

We look closely at how new work connects to the existing home. That includes framing, rooflines, siding transitions, window and door openings, water management, structure, permits, sequencing, and the details that affect how the project performs over time.

What This Means for Homeowners
Clearer planning before construction begins
Owner involvement throughout the project
Practical construction knowledge, not just sales talk
Respect for your home, schedule, and property
Attention to structure, exterior details, and water management
A More Thoughtful Approach to Remodeling
Craftsmanship

Merman Construction focuses on work that is built carefully, not rushed through. From framing and exterior details to finish selections and final walkthroughs, we pay attention to the parts of the project homeowners see every day and the parts they may never see behind the walls.

See examples in our remodeling portfolio.

Compliance

Larger remodeling projects often involve permits, inspections, township requirements, structural details, and documentation. Merman Construction helps homeowners understand what needs to happen before and during construction so the project can move forward with fewer surprises.

Learn more about planning for home additions in Montgomery and Chester County.

Serving Montgomery County & Chester County, PA

Based in Collegeville, Merman Construction works with homeowners throughout Montgomery and Chester County on larger residential construction and remodeling projects, including home additions, stucco remediation, basement remodeling, decks, exterior renovations, windows, and doors.

Explore our home additions, stucco remediation, and basement remodeling services.

YEARS ESTABLISHED

COMPLETED PROJECTS

 

About Steve Merman, Owner

Steve Merman is the Owner and Founder of Merman Construction Inc., a home remodeling and construction company serving Collegeville, PA and the surrounding Montgomery and Chester County area. With over 20 years of hands-on experience, Steve is known for quality craftsmanship, reliability, and attention to detail.

Steve began his career as a professional framer, constructing homes and residential developments for local builders. During this time, he developed a strong foundation in building systems, structural integrity, and the construction process. He later established Merman Construction Inc., focusing on exterior renovations, home additions, remodeling, and stucco remediation.

Over the past decade, Steve has received specialized training from industry leaders in diagnosing and repairing complex water intrusion and stucco-related issues, and is often called in after previous repairs have failed. This expertise allows him to accurately identify building failures and implement long-term repair solutions. Throughout his career, Steve has completed more than 1,000 residential projects and built experienced construction teams committed to high standards and client satisfaction.

Merman Construction Inc. is a locally owned and operated company based in Collegeville, PA and is committed to supporting animal rescue organizations, including City of Elderly Love Rescue and Speranza Animal Rescue. Craftsmanship, integrity, and community involvement remain central to every project.

Merman Construction Inc. is a trusted member of the Better Business Bureau for over 15 years. See our other trusted associations above.

Built on Planning and Precision

Merman Construction builds home additions that feel like they were always part of the original structure. We work with families throughout Plymouth Meeting and Montgomery County who love their location but have outgrown their space. Every addition we build is planned carefully, permitted correctly, and executed by Steve Merman and his crew from first day to final walkthrough.

 

Why Plymouth Meeting Homeowners Choose Us

Remodeling in Plymouth Meeting requires an understanding of homes built across several decades. Construction styles vary widely from postwar ranches near Germantown Pike to newer colonials in Whitemarsh Woods, and each era presents its own structural considerations. We work regularly in neighborhoods throughout Plymouth Township and understand the zoning setbacks, impervious coverage limits, and building codes required by Plymouth Township to keep your project on track and on budget.

What sets us apart is not just local knowledge, it is the level of personal involvement Steve brings to every job. He is not a salesman who hands your project off after signing. He is on site daily, managing the work, communicating with you directly, and ensuring the quality matches what was promised.

From Start to Finish

We plan every project carefully so the build is smooth, predictable, and respectful of your home and your schedule. That means thorough pre-construction planning to prevent surprises, clean and organized job sites throughout, clear communication at every stage, and a final walkthrough where nothing is considered done until you are satisfied.

 

Structural planning that prevents surprises
Clean job sites and clear communication
Quality materials installed correctly
Scheduling that respects your time

Home Additions
What We Build in Plymouth Meeting

From single story expansions to full second story additions, Merman Construction handles the complete scope of residential addition work throughout Plymouth Township. For detailed cost information visit our home additions page.

Single Story Additions: Open up kitchens, family rooms, or add flexible space.
In-Law Suites/ADUs: Independent living spaces for loved ones and guests.
Sunrooms/4-Season Rooms: Bright, insulated additions that bring in the outdoors.

 

Second Story Additions: Build upward without expanding your home’s footprint. These can be especially helpful when setbacks are in play.
Garage Conversions: Turn unused garages into high-function living space.
Bump-Out Expansions: Add space to kitchens, bathrooms, or nooks.
Home Addition

When you invest in a home addition, you’re opening up a world of possibilities. Whether you need more space for a growing family or simply want to increase your home’s value, a well-designed home addition can transform your living environment.

VIEW MORE
Bathroom Remodel

Kitchen and bathroom remodeling contractors can redefine your home, adding both functionality and aesthetic value. Whether you dream of a sleek, modern kitchen for culinary adventures or a luxurious bathroom retreat to unwind, a well-planned remodel can bring your vision to life and elevate your daily living.

VIEW MORE
Basement Renovation

A finished basement is one of the best ways to expand your home’s usable space and add long-term value. Instead of an unfinished storage or laundry area, your basement can become a welcoming extension of your home. Our team provides complete solutions: framing, insulation, electrical, and plumbing plus custom touches like wet bars, entertainment wiring, and modern lighting so the space feels as comfortable and efficient as the rest of the house.

VIEW MORE
VIEW ALL OUR SERVICES
Our Proven 5-Step Process

We make home additions simple, transparent, and stress-free from day one.

Consultation & Site Visit: We walk your property and define goals, scope, and style.
Design & Permits: We finalize your plans and handle local approvals and zoning.
Build Begins: Our team handles the foundation, framing, MEPs, and finishes.
Final Walkthrough: We handle inspections, punch list, and your final sign-off.
Warranty & Follow-Up: We stand behind our work and ensure long-term satisfaction.
VISIT OUR PROCESS PAGE TO LEARN MORE

We use materials chosen for long term performance. From exterior wall systems to tile waterproofing and ventilation upgrades each part of your project is built to last. If your architect or designer specified products we follow those details closely.
